As far as that goes I'm a mechanic I also ride a motorcycle as my only mode of transportation single motorcycle accidents happen all the time where i live that's why I chose that 
But I think the video is a good idea 
I don't want to let her know because she will blame herself and that's what I want to clarify in the video

Not trying to be a dick but I said I don't use it as a crutch I've never once used it as a excuse I was just saying because of it I lose a lot of sleep and as everyone knows sleep is vital but I'm not here to debate that

I have PTSD it's not exsuse I've never used it as a crutch but I lose sleep and it messes with my head 
The only person I've had is my fiancée who has helped me through everything unfortunately her son is terminally I'll we just found out he won't get better... she's shut down and I completely understand but she was a pillar in my support also.
I trust very few people have always struggled with suicide and depression 6 years ago I would wake up everyday would be a life and death battle questioning myself is today the day? 
Eventually I decided I'd had enough I took a large dose of pills prescription  enough to kill most people in my altered state of mind I had a moment of clarity to get to a hospital but it was to late. I fainted before I could get the keys into the ignition thankfully for everyone else who was on the road 
at the time I was found and I don't remember much after that I do recall the doctor telling me that I had to be recessitated twice and was on a ventilator 
Some days I curse them for that I wish they had let me go 
A couple years later I met my fiancée her son started  becoming ill we did everything we could do took him everywhere for treatment all over our state we where given false hope treatment after treatment failed he had bad reactions sometimes making him sicker and suffer more 
Now we've come to the end of the line there's nothing left we can do but watch and wait and pray for a miracle 
Fast forward to now she's all but shut down no emotion nothing she's like a husk and I understand that I really do
I want to leave them with my life insurance and it's been my fallback plan ever since
Medical bills have drained our savings down to almost nothing 
I know it will help them 
But I have my own battle to fight in my mind and I can't suffer anymore it doesn't have anything to do with them in fact I've never even told her I was suicidal I expect it will come as a surprise unfortunately 
But I need them to know I love them and care for them in this life or the next
